found.name: Swansea University Guidance on Artificial Intelligence for Students
found.quote: This resource sets out general guidance for Swansea University students on Generative Artificial Inteligence as it relates to your study, along with useful links to other resources.

found.name: Centre for Academic Success
found.quote: The Centre for Academic Success provides multi-faceted support for students in all things academic, including advice, guidance and support in relation to Generative AI.

found.name: Centre for Academic Success Workshops
found.quote: The Centre for Academic Success runs regular workshops including AI Literacy. This page is updated as workshops are available to book.

found.name: Microsoft Learn: Get Started with AI
found.quote: A short course (approx. 50 mins) aimed at students to help you learn the basic functions of AI

found.name: Copilot Prompt Gallery video tutorial
found.quote: This video tutorial covers how to use the Prompt Gallery to explore, customise, and reuse prompts that help you brainstorm, analyse, and create with ease.
